basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. The adopted saturation rule with its threshold raised from one saturated pixel to five, to cut the cost the rule's own proposal recorded (88 false alarms on one strip with a median of 2 saturated pixels overtaking a recorded piece) while keeping every recorded saturated piece (6 to 69 pixels). Replaces the adopted rule rather than adding to it, so it is judged as a new rule.

rules.name: saturated
rules.basis: at least five pixels at the sensor's saturation; a single saturated pixel is a bright rock facet, a patch of them is metal or a canopy
